query_generation: model chooses search arguments from user intent; never receive tool_query/relevance labels
grading: final answer identifies target event(s) and correct requested facts; missing cases explicitly report no matching record, never invent outcome. Human audit against corpus + independent model judge, preserve both.
embedding: record exact text, model id, vectors and failures for both episode and query; strict offline replay with missing/stale reported separately
test_policy: 32 test scenarios only in one final frozen run per arm/model, retain all 10 attempts; never tune after test
e2e_judge: Same fixed model in a separate request, frozen rubric; automated judgement is provisional until audited.
e2e_measurement: Isolated model-generated episode tool query plus final answer; production tool/store/projection, not full MainAgentRuntime. Existing runtime separately replayed.
